name: Liverpool John Lennon Airport
title: Liverpool John Lennon Airport guide: terminals, airlines and getting there
intro: Liverpool has one compact terminal, so there's little walking. Here's who flies from it and how to get there.

terminals.name: The terminal
terminals.text: Small and quick to get around, with short walks to the gates.

sections.heading: Getting to Liverpool Airport
sections.text:
- **Train and bus:** take the train to Liverpool South Parkway, then a short bus ride to the airport. Buses also run from Liverpool city centre.
- **Car:** the airport is in Speke, south of the city, and is easy to reach from the M62 and M56. The express drop-off is closest to the terminal, and there's a free drop-off area a short walk away.

faqs.question: Is there a train station at Liverpool Airport?
faqs.answer: No. The nearest is Liverpool South Parkway, a short bus ride away.
